featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Kotian
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m extremely disappointed with J Hearsch & Co. in Bandra. Despite being an old and reputed establishment, their quality, service, and overall experience have gone drastically downhill.

To begin with, the staff—especially the owner—were shockingly rude. It’s as if they believe they’re the only bakery that exists just because they’ve been around a while. Sadly, that attitude is exactly why this was my last visit.

Yes, the place has a legacy, but that doesn’t mean you stop upgrading where it matters. Instead of improving service and food quality, they’ve only focused on increasing their prices while everything else has degraded. The quantity has reduced significantly, and the quality is no longer what it used to be.

Here’s what I ordered:
•	Chicken Burger
•	Chicken Samosa
•	Mutton Samosa
•	Mutton Puff
•	Chicken Roll
•	Lime Water

The burger used to come with wafers in a decent box—now it’s wrapped in flimsy paper. The lime water, which once had good quantity for a reasonable price, is now expensive (₹100) and barely enough. Most items were just okay, but not worth the price or the hassle.

There is no seating, no parking, and still, customers are expected to follow a long list of rules. Instead of focusing on unnecessary regulations, they should really work on their customer service, which is currently pathetic.

Honestly, there’s no point in putting in so much effort to visit a place where the staff behaves rudely and the food no longer justifies the hype or price. I won’t be returning, and I certainly won’t recommend this bakery to anyone. Keep your attitude—I’ll take my business elsewhere.

featured_reviews.name: Murtaza Anverali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Deliciae by Bunty Mahajan: Mango Biscoff Cheesecake = Summer in a Slice*

Deliciae never misses with desserts, but the *Mango Biscoff Cheesecake* is next-level indulgence. If you think mango and Biscoff sounds risky, this will convert you.

*Presentation*: It arrives looking like art. A perfect round slice with that golden mango glaze on top, a generous dusting of Biscoff crumbs, and a caramelized Biscoff biscuit perched on the side. The layers are clean and distinct even before the first bite. You can tell it’s been set with care, not rushed.

*Taste & Texture*: This is where it becomes addictive. The base is a thick, buttery Biscoff crust that holds up without crumbling everywhere. It gives you that warm, spiced caramel note in every forkful. The cheesecake layer is insanely smooth and creamy, with a light tang that cuts through the sweetness. Then comes the mango: real Alphonso pulp, not artificial essence. It’s fresh, tropical, and balances the Biscoff beautifully so nothing feels cloying. The top glaze adds a subtle fruity brightness. Together it’s sweet, spiced, tangy, and lush.

*Overall Experience*: Each bite gives you multiple textures. Crumbly base, silky cheesecake, soft mango layer, and that little crunch from Biscoff crumbs on top. It’s rich but not heavy, and somehow feels both decadent and summery at once. Portion size is generous enough to share, though you won’t want to.

*Vibe at Deliciae*: The patisserie itself matches the dessert. Elegant, pastel, with display counters that make you want everything. Staff are super helpful and package it beautifully if you’re taking away. No soggy cheesecake disasters here.

*Verdict*: Mango + Biscoff sounds like a weird collab that should not work, but Deliciae makes it iconic. This cheesecake is indulgent, balanced, and wildly photogenic. Easily one of the best fusion desserts I have had this season.

*Pro tip*: Pair it with their cold coffee. Thank me later.

Already craving my next slice. If you’re a cheesecake or mango person, skip everything else and get this first.

featured_reviews.name: Gurvinder Pal Singh Kalra
featured_reviews.review_text:
5-Star Review for Deliciae By Bunty Mahajan
Absolutely Divine! The Hazelnut Divine Cake is a Masterpiece ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I ordered the 1kg Hazelnut Divine Cake from Deliciae By Bunty Mahajan as a special surprise for an amazing female trainer at the gym – a heartfelt thank you for all her motivation and hard work.

From the moment it arrived, it was clear this was no ordinary cake. The presentation was stunning: a glossy chocolate mirror glaze that shone beautifully, elegant swirls of rich chocolate rosettes, scattered roasted hazelnuts for that perfect crunch, and even a personalized plaque that made it feel extra thoughtful.

But the real magic happened when we cut into it – layers of moist vanilla sponge intertwined with generous chocolate ganache and crunchy roasted hazelnuts. Every bite was an explosion of decadent chocolate-hazelnut flavor, perfectly balanced, not overly sweet, and incredibly indulgent. It truly lived up to its “Divine” name!

This cake didn’t just taste extraordinary; it made her day truly special. Her smile and excitement said it all – it was the highlight of the gym ! At around ₹2631, it was worth every single rupee for the premium quality, freshness, and joy it brought.
Deliciae By Bunty Mahajan continues to be Mumbai’s best pâtisserie for a reason – flawless execution, timely delivery, and cakes that are as beautiful as they are delicious.

Highly recommend for any celebration or just to make someone’s day unforgettable. Thank you, team – you’ve gained a loyal customer!

What made this cake truly special was the use of jaggery and Ragi flour, making it not just delicious but also a healthier choice for my little one. My kid and family absolutely loved the flavor and texture, and knowing that it was made with wholesome ingredients was a bonus!

The attention to detail was amazing, especially with the customized cake toppers designed to match my kid's interests – a personal touch that made the celebration even more memorable. The cake arrived in excellent packaging, keeping it fresh and intact, ready to impress.

I highly recommend Sweegan for anyone looking for healthy, flavorful cakes that don’t compromise on quality or presentation. We'll definitely be returning customers!"

featured_reviews.name: Monish liya
featured_reviews.review_text: Finding cakes and cake premium pre mixes that are actually Nutritious, Healthy, Refined sugar Free, is actually difficult but this place has mastered the balance and tastes just amazing even youngsters or kids would love it, Their cake mixes are completely refined sugar-free, relying on high-quality ingredients like pure jaggery syrup that make you feel good about every next bite. It’s rare to find a healthy treat, but this cake which just got ready in 10mins was so spongy, rich, and flavorful. Just loved it

featured_reviews.name: Diya Rohra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Komal Ahuja's Healthy Millet Cakes are an absolute gem! The Hazelnut Chocolate Cake I recently tried was beyond delicious—it was an explosion of flavor that left me craving more. The blend of hazelnut and chocolate was simply divine, and the fact that it's made with wholesome ingredients made it even more satisfying.
For all the dark chocolate lovers, I highly suggest to opt for sugar-free dark chocolate for the toppings, it just adds feather to the hat. Whether you're health-conscious or simply looking for delicious treats that won't compromise on taste, you'll find exactly what you're looking for here.

Her sweetness extends beyond just her cakes; it's also reflected in the care and attention she puts into every aspect of it - Upon informing her that it was my dad's birthday, she immediately added a 'Super dad' ribbon that speaks volume about kindness and warmth.

Highlyy Recommend!!!

featured_reviews.name: Divya
featured_reviews.review_text:
A1 Bakery in Bandra is one of those super old-school spots tucked away in a tiny nook — no seating, just a small counter where you can grab your food and maybe stand around while you eat. We landed up here after Googling “old bakeries in Bandra,” and A1 popped up in almost every article, so naturally, we had pretty high expectations.

But honestly? It was quite underwhelming.

We tried a bunch of things — their veg and non-veg patties (both decent), the quiche (again, decent), and the very hyped-up chicken lollipops, which were… just okay. Nothing was outright bad, but nothing really wowed us either.

That said, the prices are quite reasonable. So for the price, the food is fair. But the overall experience? Meh. Definitely not something I’d go out of my way to recommend. I think the hype kind of worked against it — we walked in expecting a “hidden gem” kind of vibe and left feeling like it was all just very average.

If you’re nearby and want a quick, no-fuss bite, sure, give it a shot. But don’t expect anything iconic.

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Kini
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently stumbled upon this old-school bakery on Hill Road, located conveniently near Bandstand.

They offer a wide range of items, from puffs, croissants, and patties to cakes and muffins. While the vegetarian options are a bit limited compared to the meat selection, the taste is excellent and very fair for the price.
Note:These are budget-friendly snacks, so don't expect chunks of chicken in every bite, but the flavor is definitely there!
Also don't go by their display , if tray is empty on display they still may have it stored inside .

The staff is friendly and the service is incredibly quick. They bake in batches about three times a day, so if your choice isn't piping hot, just ask them to heat it up for you—they are happy to oblige.

Be prepared to queue up, especially on weekends and in the evenings. Even with a crowd, the line moves fast, so don't let the rush pull you away.

Pro Tip (Safety First!):
Try not to wait too long on the footpath outside. Cause once Salman Khan made a very "impactful" appearance right there with his car... and we all know how that story goes....😂😂

featured_reviews.name: Neha Kaul Pankow
featured_reviews.review_text:
They had run out of a lot of items by 11 am itself!
The chicken puff was just okay. The chicken croissant was great. The cinnamon bun was very nice - not too sweet.
Everything was nice and bite -sized. Service was quick and thoughtful. Not particularly interactive. There's standing place right there, a bit shielded from the road by shrubs and bushes. Nothing to sit on.

featured_reviews.name: Crystal Sequeira
featured_reviews.review_text:
A-1 used to be something else until a few years ago in terms of the taste and quality of their food. Even though the prices of all the window items have seen a steady increase, the quality has if anything worsened to a point of question.

I recently ordered food and spat almost all of it out in utter disgust! Chicken cutlets - no sign of chicken, huge and deceiving packed with filler (maida, cornflour, maybe a dash of potato) with an overpowering taste of cinnamon. Absolutely sickening to be duped this way. Chicken pan rolls, one of their best selling items, had sharp bones in it which could get masked under the crunch of the coating if not chewed carefully. Not to forget the horrid chunks if chewy chicken fat/ maybe the wastes of chicken on second thoughts, interspersed through this seemingly tasty roll. One word - GROSS! Mutton puffs were a saving grace, though dripping in oil, were fairly edible with some sign of meat. Non vegetarians, ditch this place. Vegetarians - if you’re a fan of cornflour and maida filler, this place is a go to!

Never ever eating from this place again!

Been meaning to visit this place for what seemed like forever but the wait times always make me decide to walk away. This time we decided to wait since the wait for a table was just 10-15 minutes.

We were seated in the third cafe but since we didn't like the atmosphere we asked if we could sit in the main cafe, the staff were pleasant and said it wasn't a problem we just needed to wait a few more minutes while they free up a table.

We got our table and were seated on the top section, the seating is unique and if you're tall please mind your head 😅.

We ordered just coffee this time but to be fair one of the coffees was more dessert than coffee (I'm not complaining). So the coconut cold brew which I got wasn't particularly my favourite, I honestly didn't care much for the combination of coconut and coffee but my wife did enjoy it.

The other "drink" that we got was the Iced EDCM which also the coffee part I didn't care for much and neither did my wife but what was amazing was the mousse, that chocolate mousse was delicious and just should be enjoyed on it own.

One thing I didn't like though was in most of the coffee options there's a statement made in the description "choice of milk" which would normally mean you get to choose the milk of your choice as it's included in the price but it isn't. On the top of the menu it gives you a list of milk options and a price but I naturally assumed this would be the case if you chose to swap the milk of your given drink to another but no it applies to all drinks including the ones that ask for your choice of milk. The wording should be made clear or the servers should relay this message to the guests even if it's not a huge amount. In fact a table next to us also didn't expect the charge on their bill as they weren't aware.

featured_reviews.name: Ninad joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to this spot on Saturday morning for breakfast, and it turned out to be a fantastic experience for us.

We ordered one Cortado, a large Pain au Chocolat, a spicy chicken-stuffed hash brown, an avocado chicken sandwich, and a Caramel Latte.

The cortado was incredible; it's a traditional Spanish espresso drink made with double espresso and 60 ml of milk. It had a bitter flavour, but I really enjoyed it.

The large pain au chocolat was absolutely delicious, a classic pastry crafted from buttery, flaky, laminated dough (similar to croissant dough) wrapped around dark chocolate sticks.

The spicy chicken-stuffed hash brown was tasty, featuring shredded potatoes filled with cooked chicken, pan-fried until golden and crispy.The avocado chicken sandwich was mouthwatering and highly recommended. It was a fresh, nutritious, and versatile meal made with thin slices of chicken and avocado. Simply delightful.

The caramel latte was incredibly refreshing. It’s a sweet and creamy coffee drink typically made with espresso, steamed milk, and caramel syrup.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great experience at Boojee Cafe. Absolutely loved how this cafe is designed-it may look small from the outside, but the interiors are planned so well that it feels surprisingly spacious and comfortable once you step in. It’s a perfect spot for a quick bite with friends or even a casual catch-up over coffee.

The place gets quite packed on weekends. We went on a Saturday and had to wait around 5–10 minutes for a table, which honestly just shows how popular the cafe is.

The food and coffee here are fantastic. The House Cold Coffee was suggested to us and it truly lived up to the hype, a must-try if you’re a genuine coffee lover. We also tried the Orange Cold Brew. Personally, I didn’t enjoy it as much, but it definitely feels like an acquired taste, so cold brew enthusiasts should still give it a shot.

For food, we tried the Chicken & Veggies Mini Wrap and it was amazing, especially the dip served alongside it which paired perfectly with the wrap.

Another big plus point was the staff and service. The staff is friendly, welcoming and the service is impressively quick despite the crowd.

Overall, a really nice cafe with great vibes, good food and excellent coffee. Would definitely recommend checking it out if you’re in and around Bandra.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Boojee Cafe in Bandra West, Mumbai, has received rave reviews from visitors. Here's what they're saying
- *Ambiance*: The cafe has a cozy, quaint atmosphere with a beautiful combination of simple black and white decor. It's perfect for relaxed conversations, meetings or just unwinding with a good cup of coffee.
- *Food*: The menu offers a range of options, including Greek salads, espresso dark chocolate mousse, ABC apple beetroot carrot juice and mushroom bruschetta. Visitors have praised the food, saying it's "awesome" and "delicious".
- *Service*: The staff is extremely friendly, cute and knowledgeable about the menu. They provide quick service, making it a great spot for busy professionals or groups.
- *Value for Money*: While some visitors felt the prices were a bit steep, others believed the quality and experience justified the cost. The average price range is around ₹500-₹1,000 for two people.

*Some notable mentions*:
- *Greek Salad*: Fresh cucumbers, salad leaves, feta cheese, black olives, cherry tomatoes and a lovely dressing.
- *Espresso Dark Chocolate Mousse*: Light, melt-in-your-mouth texture and rich flavor.
- *ABC Apple Beetroot Carrot Juice*: Refreshing and perfect for health-conscious visitors.

*Overall Experience*: Boojee Cafe has a 4.4-star rating on Restaurant Guru and 4.5-star rating on Tripadvisor, with visitors praising its great ambiance, delicious food and excellent service

featured_reviews.name: Chirag
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved our visit to Boojee Cafe in Mumbai! The eggs benedict with salmon were spot on, and the Turkish eggs were also great —rich, flavourful, and perfectly balanced. The pistachio croissant was heavenly.

Such a refreshing find in India—this place genuinely feels like an Australasian-style café, from the quality of the food to the overall vibe. Great coffee, great menu, and a really relaxed atmosphere. Highly recommend if you’re after a proper brunch experience!

I started with a slice of their velvety cheesecake: rich, creamy, and just the right amount of sweetness. Then came the gelato — incredibly smooth with bold, natural flavors that didn’t overpower. featured_reviews.review_text: All the products are mouth watering. They have a variety of pastries which are amazing and cakes are awesome too.
